description: Every Boolean algebra is Boolean isomorphic to the Stone map range, by an order isomorphism whose underlying map is the Stone map.
signature:
Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stone_representation.{u} {B : Type u} [BooleanAlgebra B] :
  ∃ e, ∀ (a : B), ↑(e a) = Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BooleanAlgebras.stoneMap a
